assumptions: Supplier matched by exact name 'Kanto Precision' (case-sensitive as stored). The count is distinct product_id values in products linked to that supplier.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS distinct_products, COUNT(*) AS product_rows
FROM products p
JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE s.name = 'Kanto Precision';
